change: Init-threshold relaxation loop now matches COLMAP's Run (.cc:418-445): five stages (100,16),(50,16),(50,8),(25,8),(25,4) instead of three.
conclusion: The 5-stage relaxation is a safe fidelity fix (2.5k unchanged at 0.0712; models are found at stage 1 so the extra stages do not fire on 2.5k). COLMAP's model0 initial pair (frames 446/462 cam2) has only ~1.8 deg parallax and 59 direct matches, yet COLMAP accepts it after relaxation while the port rejects it; the port's initial-pair selection/inlier set therefore still differs from COLMAP's E-matrix path. The combined 5-stage+ray-angle run improved 10k to ATE 2.91/sim3 1.314 (still 1 model) but regressed 2.5k, so only the 5-stage fix is kept.
next: Match the initial two-view estimator/inlier set to COLMAP's EstimateTwoViewGeometry so the accepted initial pair matches.
Re-check whether COLMAP's control build accepts a 1.8 deg pair at all (pinned 64805cb Run uses a final tri threshold of 4 deg), i.e. whether the control matches the pinned source.
ray_angle_investigation: COLMAP computes the initial-pair tri_angle as the median angle between the two viewing rays after rotating image2's ray into image1's frame (two_view_geometry.cc:790-805); the port triangulated each pair with a DLT and measured the angle at the 3D point. Switching to the faithful ray-angle yields 1.85 deg for COLMAP's model0 pair (image 5446/cam2 t=18.390 vs 5462), matching COLMAP model0's post-BA median of 1.79 deg. But that change regressed 2.5k to 0.0794 (above COLMAP's 0.0718), so it is not included in this change; it lives as an isolated finding.
